svg.title: Wireframe 8: group board on a tablet and a desktop
svg.desc: Greyscale wireframes of the LiftOff Comp group board on a landscape tablet (1024 px) and a desktop (1366 px): the next-lifter panel and the tracked lifter in a left column, the lifter table next to it, and on the desktop the Clean and Jerk list beside the Snatch list. Two cut-outs show the row menu as a popover and refused weights as messages under the row.
svg.text: Wireframe 8 · Group board · tablet (1024 px) and desktop (1366 px)
Same components and states as the phone wireframes. Greyscale layout only: colours, fonts and icons are placeholders. Frames are drawn at 90 % size. Names and numbers are made up.
Tablet, landscape (1024 × 768)

g.text: 29 kg per side on a 15 kg bar
below, starts when Snatch is done

svg.text: Two columns
Left: everything for the current attempt (next
lifter, plates, flags, Enter result) and the tracked
lifter. Right: the lifter table. The left column
stays in place while the table scrolls.
Bigger T-minus
On wide screens the tracked lifter gets a card
with a large 'T–4'. A second tracked lifter
is one line under it.
Wider table
Bodyweight gets a column (weigh-in). The
Clean & Jerk list sits under the Snatch list,
as on the phone.
Touch
Tap targets stay at least 44 px. The flags and
Enter result are in the left column, close to
the thumb when the tablet is held in landscape.
Desktop (1366 × 720)

g.text: 29 kg per side on a 15 kg bar

svg.text: Same left column as the tablet. The Snatch and Clean & Jerk lists sit side by side: the list that is not in play is dimmed.
When the Snatch is done the Clean & Jerk list gets full colour and the Snatch list is dimmed. The bodyweight column is left out to save width.
The sticky bar from the phone is not needed here: the tracked card is always visible in the left column.
Cut-outs: states from wireframe 2 on a wide screen
A
Row menu as a popover
On wide screens the menu opens as a popover under the
name instead of a strip that pushes the rows down.
B
Refused weights

g.text: Weight can not be lower than 73 kg
Weight can not be higher than 62 kg

svg.text: The message is a row under the lifter, as on the phone. The
cell keeps its old value, a red outline and a ! badge.
